rows.grounds: compound denoting the principal ritual seat; object of construction
refers back to the great pedestal
fused form lakṣaṇam + ucyate; introduces the defining marks to be described

items.question: What defining characteristics must be specified for constructing the great pedestal?
premises: A great pedestal is to be constructed.
That great pedestal possesses specific defining characteristics.
Those defining characteristics are now to be stated.
items.inference: The ritual prescription requires that the construction of the great pedestal be guided by its explicitly stated defining characteristics.
items.plain_english: The great pedestal should be made; its defining characteristics are now stated.
